native_clock: Synthetic2ms-aligned API identity tokens in100ns units. Source PTS/POC association is independently parsed, not measured firmware DPB state or calibrated A/V.
scope: Research test probes only; same installed stable module/signed firmware/library/PM, no application patch/default/API/ABI/release change. G2 remains FAIL; nonempty drained V4L2 START remains EOPNOTSUPP.
oracle_reuse: Existing native20 oracle; not a new reference run. New full180 oracle below independently matches each of its20 full images/flags.

decision.result: Only actual-next-AU early token preserves its identity. The own token on resumed VCL does not override the early token. Generic/previous markers advance4/5 private pictures but fail strict native identity.
decision.reused_generic_marker_across_cycles: NOT RUN: no no-lookahead candidate passed P1.
decision.raw_untimed_control: Previously failed raw control reproduced with new attribution; not a novel workaround.
decision.prefer_ordinary_pause: No-dummy input-only idle/resume requires neither private pictures nor next-AU lookahead.
decision.limits: No inferred output retagging; no integration/default promotion; no firmware instruction/physical PPB lease/STOP-START claim.
decision.same_token_on_multiple_private_pictures: NOT RUN: identical DC128 private images/flags cannot independently distinguish the source private picture once their distinct native tokens are lost.
decision.repeat_final_private_token_on_real_prefi: NOT RUN: optional arm outside the measured A-D matrix. The current native observer deliberately requires every private-range token to carry a neutral private image; handling a collision between an original image and a private-range token needs a separately validated diagnostic classification. This is not a claim that the optional control is intrinsically unmeasurable.
